post.description: Resolve a PennBid ProjectID or a pasted https://pennbid.bonfirehub.com/opportunities/... URL to its listing record and learn whether it is still open or already closed/awarded.

200.description:
One PennBid opportunity's public listing record, found by Bonfire ProjectID or by a pasted detail URL (/opportunities/{ProjectID} or /opportunities/private/{PrivateProjectID}): name, awarding agency reference, status ids, closing date (UTC), award flag and which list (open or past) it sits in. Searches the open list first, then the full past list; an id in neither is `not_found`. The detail page (statement of work, open/questions dates, documents, Q&A, bid results) is behind a Cloudflare managed challenge and is not read by this version.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `date_close` | string | Closing instant in UTC. |
| `department_id` | string |  |
| `is_public_award` | boolean | Bonfire IsPublicAward from the past list (the award decision is published); null for open opportunities, which carry no such flag. |
| `listing` | string | Which public list the record came from: `open` (accepting submissions) or `past` (closed). |
| `name` | string |  |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |
| `private_project_id` | string |  |
| `project_id` | string |  |
| `reference` | string | Awarding agency and county as PennBid fills Bonfire's ReferenceID. |
| `status_id` | number | Bonfire ProjectStatusID as stated (3, 4, 5 observed); labels are not resolved here. |
| `sub_status_id` | number |  |
| `url` | string |  |
| `visibility_id` | number |  |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.

post.description: Find currently open bids/RFPs on PennBid by keyword (project name or awarding agency) or closing window, then pass `project_id` to `get_opportunity`.

closing_from.description: Keep opportunities closing at or after this UTC instant. A date alone means the start of that day (00:00:00Z). Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}(T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}Z)?$.

closing_to.description: Keep opportunities closing at or before this UTC instant. A date alone means the end of that day (23:59:59Z). Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}(T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}Z)?$.

200.description:
Open (accepting submissions) public opportunities on PennBid, from the portal's JSON listing endpoint. The upstream endpoint returns the complete list in one response and accepts no parameters; the text filter, date window and paging are applied by this program. Sorted by closing date ascending, then project id. All dates are UTC (ISO 8601 `Z`), converted from the portal's UTC database strings.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `items` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `date_close` | string | Closing instant in UTC. |
| `department_id` | string | Bonfire DepartmentID; the portal publishes no department lookup table for this tenant. |
| `name` | string |  |
| `private_project_id` | string | Bonfire PrivateProjectID; alternate detail URL /opportunities/private/{id}. |
| `project_id` | string | Bonfire ProjectID; the key for `get_opportunity` and the detail URL. |
| `reference` | string | Bonfire ReferenceID as PennBid fills it: the awarding agency and county, free text (not a bid number). |
| `status_id` | number | Bonfire ProjectStatusID as stated by the portal (2 observed for open projects); labels are rendered client-side and are not resolved here. |
| `sub_status_id` | number |  |
| `url` | string | Public detail page https://pennbid.bonfirehub.com/opportunities/{project_id}. |
| `visibility_id` | number |  |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.

200.description:
Past (closed) public opportunities on PennBid, from the portal's JSON listing endpoint: every closed project back to late 2023 (about 8,000 records, one ~3 MB upstream response). The endpoint accepts no parameters; the text filter, closing-date window, status and award filters and paging are applied by this program. Sorted by closing date descending, then project id. All dates are UTC (ISO 8601 `Z`).

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `items` as the primary payload key.

| `is_public_award` | boolean | Bonfire IsPublicAward: the award decision is published on the detail page. |
| `name` | string |  |
| `private_project_id` | string |  |
| `project_id` | string |  |
| `reference` | string | Awarding agency and county as PennBid fills Bonfire's ReferenceID. |
